deploybot: Production deploy starting — env=prod commit=7f9d2c tag=release-3.6.0-rc4 rollout_id=rb-2026-03-19-4950123456. Triggered by @alex. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC.

alex: kicking off cutover now. will pin canary at 5% and watch for errors/latency.

jin: observability pre-checks done. traces and p50/p95 baselines uploaded. watching seq-len and kv-cache pressure.

maya: i'll tail inference logs and alert on any OOM or sustained 5xx. threshold: error_rate > 0.5% or latency_p95 > 300ms => manual pause/rollback. :eyes: 

ops: handing off post-cutover smoke to oncall @sara. sara pls stand by. :hand: 

sara: ack, standing by. will validate traffic distribution and data plane health.

deploybot: Canary rollout: 5% -> success. checks: error_rate 0.08% (ok), latency_p95 +3ms (within SLO). shifting to 30%.

alex: note — no config flips, just model variant swap. keep an eye on cache-miss rate.

ci-bot: CI: promote job completed, pinned prod tag release-3.6.0-rc4 -> 7f9d2c. artifacts uploaded: s3://releases/redwood/release-3.6.0-rc4/

deploybot: Traffic at 30% -> 100% in scheduled increments. next checkpoint in 4m.

jin: small cpu bump on a single node, autoscaler compensated. not impacting latency. continuing monitor.

alex: rolling to 100% now. pause conditions reiterated: error_rate > 0.5% OR new alert on memory.

deploybot: Cutover complete. All traffic on tag=release-3.6.0-rc4 (commit 7f9d2c). rollout_id rb-2026-03-19-4950123456. Post-cutover quick checks: error_rate -0.02% vs baseline, latency_p95 +4ms. No rollback required. :white_check_mark:

maya: logs look clean. seeing expected KV cache warmups, hit-rate improving.

sara: validated endpoints, tracing looks normal, can close handoff.

alex: thanks team — will add short release note and link changelog. https://go/release/4950123456

maya: i'll draft the blurb and post to #announcements in 15m. :memo:
